verdict.rationale: Stripe's official stripe/openapi GitHub repository README says "Use these files to generate SDKs or client libraries that support Stripe's API," which shows first-party, downloadable OpenAPI spec files. The probe's 404s at guessed docs.stripe.com paths do not contradict this, since the spec is published in the GitHub repo rather than at those URLs. missing for 10: details on spec format/versions and update cadence, a hands-on probe successfully fetching the spec file, independent corroboration of its completeness
